To express the number in Cartesian form, we expand the parentheses and substitute the values of the cosine and sine.

Since $\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})=0$ and $\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})=1$, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}z & =10(\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2})) \\  & =10(0+\text{i}) \\  & =10\text{ }\,\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
